fields.title: 📖 Calling the soul to account
fields.body:
🖋️ **Al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī** (Tābiʿī) said in meaning:

“The believer **watches over himself** and *calls himself to account for the sake of Allāh.*

The reckoning on the Day of Resurrection will be **easier** for those who *have already called themselves to account in this world.*

**The reckoning, by contrast, will be heavy** for those who have conducted their affairs *without accountability.*”

🌙 **Conclusion:** **The cultivation of one’s own soul begins with sincere self-examination.** Whoever recognizes his faults, masters his desires and calls himself to account strives for the **purification of his soul** and obedience toward Allāh.

immutable.source: 📝 Quelle: Ibn al-Mubārak, az-Zuhd wa-r-Raqāʾiq, Nr. 307, Bd. 1, S. 104; Ibn Abī Shaybah, al-Muṣannaf, Kitāb az-Zuhd, Bd. 8, S. 257, Bericht 23 (ausgabenabhängig).
